title: DataUnderstandability
description: ISO 25012-sourced data quality archetype — Understandability inherent-and-system data quality characteristic. The degree to which data has attributes that enable it to be read and interpreted by users, and is expressed in appropriate languages, symbols, and units in a specific context of use. Rootless archetype — used as qualifier in Directives/Norms governing data entities. Source: ISO/IEC 25012 (Inherent and System-Dependent Data Quality — Understandability).

understandabilityLevel.description: Degree of data understandability. OPAQUE = requires specialized knowledge to interpret. TECHNICAL = understandable with technical documentation. DOCUMENTED = accompanied by business-level metadata. SELF_DESCRIPTIVE = inherently understandable with labels, units, and context.

metadataAvailable.description: Whether descriptive metadata (data dictionaries, business glossary entries) is available.

standardNotation.description: Whether data uses standard notations, units, and symbols recognized by the target audience.
